body:
**Handoff from MMR-44 (generation job).** See `docs/generation-job.md`.

- **The commit seam.** `GenerationCoordinator.Commit(job, ICommitStage)` runs from ReadyForReview only. Your stage's `Commit(job)` runs on a worker. Engine work goes through `job.Engine(label, work, discard)` (bounded engine-thread items carrying the job ticket) or `job.Teardown`. `Recover(job, error)` runs before the job fails. Committing is never cancelled.
- **What a job at ReadyForReview holds** (owned resources are released in reverse order unless your commit calls `job.Disown(name)`):
  - **`bundle <WorldContentId>`:** a bundle this job published under `SubModule.Store/bundles`. A reused bundle is not owned.
  - **`world generation N`:** the `GenerationToken` that `SceneStage` began (`job.Get<GenerationToken>("generation")`). `GeneratedMapScene.Load` begins its own generation, so decide whether to retire or disown this one.
  - **Artifacts:** `bundleDirectory`, `bundle` (the verified `WorldDataBundle`), `worldContentId`, `manifestSha256`, `sceneName`, `navmeshSha256`, `navigationReport`, `navigationActivatable`, `requestId`, `attemptSeed`.
- **The scene.** It is installed and registered (`SceneObj/<sceneName>`) and validated in an inspection scene that is already disposed. The persisted navigation report is what `NavigationGate.Require` checks at map load.
- **R07 order.** Campaign registration must happen inside the new game's `RegisterSubModuleObjects` (the job's RegisteringCampaign phase only reports this).
- **Forward risk.** Every install sweeps other worlds' scene folders this process has not used, so loading a saved world must re-install its scene from its bundle.
- **One job at a time.** `Start` refuses while a job is unfinished or still being released (`GenerationBusyException`, `AwaitIdle`).
